original_requirement: TODO22: Lightweight def-use (data-flow) edges, including method-local definition/use and cross-method parameter linking so trace_data_flow answers lineage questions that currently require source reading.
observed_missing_behavior: Current trace_data_flow combines line-oriented .NET control/state/SQL parsing with bounded Calls follow. DataFlowTrace has no value lineage field; graph EdgeKind has no local def/use relation. Existing ParameterBinding is WebForms SQL-data-source parameter binding, not method argument-to-parameter lineage. No prior TODO22 delivery receipt found.
scope_basis: TODO22 is in the existing P1 graph-value backlog; trace_data_flow is advertised as .NET legacy and parses C#/VB. P2 language generalization stays separately open.

observations.finding: No variable definition/use representation or argument-to-parameter lineage; existing call/state/SQL traces are preserved.
ParameterBinding exists, but no method-local def/use relation.
parameter_binding is control/state-to-SQL parameter evidence, not callable value lineage.

finite_acceptance: Store source-located definition/use evidence for parameters, local declarations, assignments, reads, returns and call arguments in the existing C#/VB trace workflows. Variable identity must include method and lexical scope; reassignment must not invent stale straight-line lineage.

Post-ingest linking connects actual argument uses to the corresponding parameter only when the existing source call binding and argument mapping establish the target. Ambiguous/external/unsupported flows remain visibly incomplete, not guessed.

Expose bounded, source-cited lineage through existing trace_data_flow JSON and readable output, allowing an agent to follow an input through local aliases into a helper parameter and a returned/consumed value. Report branch/loop/alias uncertainty and truncation honestly; no whole-program or runtime-proof claim.

Use independently authored C# and real VB sidecar fixtures to verify local aliases, overwritten values, same-name scopes, argument positions and cross-method links; negative cases cover unresolved calls and unsupported control-flow without false proven paths.

Incremental source replacement and graph_only repair retract obsolete value edges while preserving source/search/vector storage. Reuse existing acceptance/deployment tooling; run relevant native/no-vector/sidecar checks and verify candidate plus installed public lineage before completion.
limitations: This is source evidence of the missing behavior, not a runtime baseline or implementation. Public fixture evidence is still required.
